Event: Kelbury summit.
Catering: Plated dinner.
Schedule/Location Changes: Evening stand-up moved to the print room. Afternoon stand-up moved to the east wing.
Room Preferences: Cora wants the harbour room kept clear for visitors. Garden studio is being repainted, causing evening noise. Print room is also being repainted, causing morning noise. Coffee machine in the garden studio is working again.
Staffing: Dell is out for the rest of the week; Teo is covering. Greta and Dell are swapping desks this week.
Other Notes: Someone left an umbrella in the north office. Bram thinks the north office is too cold in the morning. Lift near the library annex is slow today.
Pending Actions: Assistant offered to draft a note to Vik regarding the print room changes. Reminder needed: Kira prefers the loading bay for reviews.
